changelog: New, free for everyone: Capture. Take a screenshot of the full screen or an area, or record your screen with system sound and microphone, from the notch's new camera tab or the Screenshot and Record buttons on Home.
New for Pro (beta): Smart Morph. The closed notch reshapes itself for music, the Focus timer, charging and battery, and finished downloads. Settings, Widgets, Smart Morph.
New in Settings: open the notch on the last tab you used, and choose the order of the notch's tabs.
Fixed: on some PCs, settings and Notchy changes could fail to save.
Fixed: the Pro price no longer shows "??" in place of the currency sign.
AI agent alerts no longer take keyboard focus from the app you are typing in.
Download sizes now also show for Opera, Vivaldi and Arc.

highlight.title: Meet Capture and Smart Morph
highlight.text: Capture takes screenshots and records your screen from the notch, free for everyone. Smart Morph (Pro, beta) reshapes the notch for music, focus, power and downloads. Turn it on in Settings, Widgets.
